  COUNT(*) AS total_home_matches,
  SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_wins,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS win_percentage
FROM Matches
WHERE strftime('%Y', start_date) >= '2001'
GROUP BY team1
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.start_date >= '2015-01-01'
AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia'
GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

ORDER BY wickets DESC
LIMIT 5;
